# Jannik Buschke's Developer Blog

> > A software development blog focused on F# functional programming, ASP.NET Core backend architecture, and modern web development with React and Fable.

Jannik Buschke shares practical guides and tutorials on building scalable web applications using CQRS patterns, OData queryable APIs, and F# tooling like Fable and Feliz. The site emphasizes pragmatic architectural patterns and developer productivity tools.

## Key Topics

- F# and Fable
- ASP.NET Core
- OData queryable APIs
- CQRS with MediatR
- React and SPA development
- Feliz and Elmish
- Git Submodules
- Monorepo architecture
- Model validation patterns
- TypeScript
- Functional programming
- Fable.Remoting
- Vite build tooling
- EnableQuery attribute
- Repository management

## Getting Started

- [Hi I am Jannik, Welcome to my little corner!](https://jannikbuschke.de): Homepage: Jannik's developer portfolio featuring F#, Event Sourcing, React
- [Latest Blog Posts](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2): Blog index: F#, Fable, CQRS, OData, and ASP.NET Core articles
- [Useful git examples](https://jannikbuschke.de/snippets): Code snippets: Git, C#, F#, SQL Server, Azure DevOps, ASP.NET examples

## F# and Fable Development

- [Getting started with Fable and Feliz](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/getting-started-with-fable-and-feliz): Tutorial: Setting up Fable and Feliz with Vite for F# web development

## ASP.NET Core API Patterns

- [Exposing a queryable api with Odata](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/odata-getting-started): Getting started: Building queryable APIs with OData and ASP.NET Core
- [CQRS with MediatR (for Commands) and Odata (for Queries)](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/cqrs-with-mediatr-and-odata): Implementation guide: CQRS pattern with MediatR commands and OData queries
- [Make ASP.NET Core api controller methods queryable with a single attribute](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/webapi-enable-query): Tutorial: Using [EnableQuery] attribute for queryable ASP.NET Core APIs
- [Expose ASP.NET Core validation for SPAs like React, Vue or Angular](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/expose-aspnetcore-validation): Guide: Exposing ASP.NET Core validation via HTTP for SPA clients

## Repository and Monorepo Management

- [A (multi-) monorepo setup with Git Submodules](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/git-submodules): Tutorial: Managing monorepos with Git Submodules for code sharing
- [A monorepo setup with lerna](https://jannikbuschke.de/blog2/monorepo-with-lerna-react-and-typescript): Walk-through: Setting up Lerna monorepo with React and TypeScript
